# Scarsdale Chinese Association (SCA)

> Scarsdale Chinese Association (斯卡斯代尔华人协会) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-political community organization serving Chinese families in Scarsdale, New York, founded in 2018. It runs a Spring Festival (Lunar New Year) Gala, youth concerts, seasonal festivals, coffee mornings, educational seminars and a weekly Senior Club, and partners with the Village of Scarsdale.

Key facts
- Family membership: $40 per year per household, paid by card (Stripe) or Zelle. Join at https://scarsdalechinese.com/join/
- Contact: info@scarsdalechinese.com · (703) 798-7886 · P.O. Box 172, Scarsdale, NY 10583
- Senior Club: every Tuesday 9:30–11:30 AM, September–June, at the Girl Scout House, 37 Wayside Lane, Scarsdale. Run with the Village of Scarsdale ($15/yr Village fee).
- Sponsorship and tax-deductible donations: https://scarsdalechinese.com/sponsors/
- Website source: https://github.com/scarsdale-chinese-association/scarsdalechinese.com
